The unmodified runtime binary is Plain Craft Launcher 2/Resources/transformer.jar.
SHA-256: ea5756fec2e06d5aa5824b54f9c26ae46a7ab43ca9a57e747f1f63e1269f7dad
Git blob: 3ea51be50926e0b72ac87e7c8e73086edbbd6f04

That blob exactly matches the binary included with the corresponding source at
HMCL commit 7c510f9fb8655598a26b1b5937bcb0046d0960d4:
https://github.com/HMCL-dev/HMCL/blob/7c510f9fb8655598a26b1b5937bcb0046d0960d4/HMCLCore/src/main/resources/assets/game/HMCLTransformerDiscoveryService-1.0.jar

The component source, service registration, upstream build scripts, GPL text,
and additional terms are supplied in this directory and embedded in the
launcher. In the About page, use the source export button to save these
machine-readable files, including the build instructions and compile-only API.

The compile-api directory preserves the actual ModLauncher 4.1.0 interface
definition, Copyright (C) 2017-2019 cpw, under LGPLv3; its LICENSE, COPYING and
COPYING.LGPL are included. The API is used only to compile the component and
is not included in transformer.jar. See SOURCE.md for fixed source locations.

LF added source packaging, an offline build script, and these provenance
records on 2026-11-08. The HMCL Java source and existing runtime JAR are unchanged.
These component terms do not replace other files' copyright or licenses.
Exact artifact identity is not a legal audit of the whole launcher.
